user.title: Helpmeet: Assist Learner
user.description:
Assist Learner watches your LLM conversation agent. When the same command succeeds repeatedly, it proposes a local sentence for you to approve in Repairs. {prefer_local_note}

Commands that touch these domains are never learned: {denylist_floor}.

data.replay_enabled: Also learn multi-step commands and scripts

data_description.threshold: How many times the same wording must produce the same actions before you're asked to approve it.
data_description.replay_enabled: Approved commands that do several things at once or run a script are replayed locally, like learned sentences. Your Assist pipeline and its agent stay as they are.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Assist Learner is already set up.
abort.no_llm_agent: No LLM conversation agent is set up. Add one (for example OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Ollama) first.
abort.unsupported: Capture can't run on this Home Assistant: {reason}

capture_paused.title: Assist Learner stopped learning
capture_paused.description:
Assist Learner can't read conversations on this Home Assistant version: {reason}.

It relies on internal parts of the conversation integration that changed. Learned sentences keep working. Update Assist Learner, or report this at https://github.com/Helpmeeters/assist-learner/issues.

capture_watchdog.title: Assist Learner hasn't learned anything in a week
capture_watchdog.description: Conversations are happening, but Assist Learner hasn't recognized any LLM actions in them for 7 days. This usually means a Home Assistant update changed how conversations are logged. Update Assist Learner, or report this at https://github.com/Helpmeeters/assist-learner/issues.

export_failed.title: Assist Learner couldn't write some sentences
export_failed.description:
These approved commands weren't added to custom_sentences, so your existing local commands stay safe: {details}.

Forget or reject them, or edit the sentence with the assist_learner.approve action.

replay_agent_removed.title: Assist pipeline uses the removed Assist Learner Replay agent
replay_agent_removed.description:
These Assist pipelines still use the Assist Learner Replay agent, which no longer exists: {pipelines}.

Multi-step commands and scripts are now replayed locally, so the pipeline can use your own agent directly. In **Settings > Voice assistants**, set each pipeline's conversation agent back to {agent} and keep **Prefer handling commands locally** on. This issue clears the next time Assist Learner loads.

nothing_to_learn.message: There's no recent command that can be learned. Say an action command to your LLM agent first.

approve.name: Approve
approve.description: Approves a learned command and writes it to custom_sentences.

reject.name: Reject
reject.description: Rejects a learned command. Its wording is never proposed again.

forget.name: Forget
forget.description: Deletes a learned command and removes it from custom_sentences.

learn_last.name: Learn last command
learn_last.description: Sends the most recent learnable command straight to review, without waiting for it to repeat.
